only_gemini.text: With no MessagePack attributes on T, serialization defaults to contractless behaviour over public members.
Nothing needs to be added to the assembly that declares T, and no new runtime dependency or runtime reflection over user-defined attribute copies is introduced.
Behaviour of existing [MessagePackObject] types and existing formatters is unchanged.

only_claude_texts.C2: Without a surrogate, the generated formatter writes every public read-write instance property and field of T as a string-keyed map entry named after the member.
only_claude_texts.C3: Attributes that are present on T are used for the wire contract.
only_claude_texts.C5: The fixture assembly that declares the formatted types has no MessagePack reference, so the feature works without adding anything to the assembly that owns T.
only_claude_texts.C6: Hand-written formatters and existing generated formatters are unaffected: the exclusion in the formatter search only matches classes carrying the new attribute, and the template keeps 'internal sealed class' for every other formatter.
only_claude_texts.C10: A surrogate type's [Key] and [IgnoreMember] attributes decide which members are written and under which keys, with members matched by name and type.
only_claude_texts.C11: Adding the public attribute class GeneratedMessagePackFormatterAttribute to the MessagePack.Annotations assembly is additive and does not change existing public API.
